simple.meaning: מִן (min) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “according, after, because, before, by, for, from, × him, × more than, (out) of, part, since, × these, to, upon, when.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 116 times across Ezra, Jeremiah, Daniel, beginning at Ezra 4:12. Its contexts include family, kingship, city.
